conventions.dividends: Prior holders receive cash on ex-date (explicit simplifying assumption); no DRIP
conventions.execution: Next session open; integer shares; no leverage; no partial fills or order carry
conventions.impact: Order reference value / previous N sessions average daily traded value, strict threshold; not portfolio allocation fraction
conventions.prices: As-traded OHLC; signal history adjusted for splits known by that close; no dividend adjustment
conventions.signal: Strict crossing after close; equality holds prior position; initially cash; pre-period crossings ignored except previous-close order
conventions.terminal: Mark open positions at last close; no fictional forced liquidation
conventions.win_rate: Positive net PnL / closed round trips, including fees and received dividends; open positions excluded
